units.function: Maps server IssueRecoveryAction status/kind/outcome into five UI display states and English recovery-chip labels/icons/tones.
units.dependencyDirection: Pure UI helper importing shared Paperclip recovery types and Lucide icons; it contains no API calls or persistence.
units.keyDataModels: RecoveryDisplayState needed/in_progress/observe_only/escalated/resolved and active recovery action status, kind and outcome.
units.lifecycle: Derive resolved/escalated/observe-only/delegated/needed presentation and choose a workspace-specific label for one case.
units.testAssessment: Four small tests cover workspace-specific versus generic labels and one active workspace-validation state. They omit the full status/kind/outcome cross-product, cancelled, delegated, active-run watchdog and future enum exhaustiveness.
units.designRationale: Centralize semantic status-to-presentation mapping instead of scattering chip logic across pages.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS Web needs a projection boundary that maps stable domain codes to localized clay-style visual states without storing display copy in the domain.
units.companyOsFit: REFERENCE the pure projection pattern only. Company OS should own exhaustive typed mappings and localization keys; it must not reuse Paperclip copy, icons or recovery taxonomy as a runtime dependency.
units.responsibilityConflict: The display collapses cancelled into resolved and delegated into in-progress without showing who holds responsibility, whose approval is pending or whether evidence is complete.

units.function: Client-side affordance helpers for a runtime-manage break-glass workspace reconcile action and extraction of the execution-workspace target from workspace-validation recovery evidence.
units.dependencyDirection: Imports shared RecoveryAction and UI CurrentBoardAccess types. It explicitly mirrors, but does not enforce, backend authorization; IssueDetail is the consumer and the server remains authoritative.
units.keyDataModels: Board access source/admin/company IDs/memberships and workspace-validation evidence containing persistedExecutionWorkspaceId or executionWorkspaceId.
units.lifecycle: Hide runtime controls for absent/foreign/inactive/viewer access; allow local implicit/admin/non-viewer membership; prefer the workspace pinned in recovery evidence over page-level mutable Issue state.
units.testAssessment: IssueDetail tests cover fallback company IDs, viewer denial, non-viewer allow, missing/wrong-kind/malformed evidence and precedence between two workspace IDs. They do not cover all roles/statuses, permission-key overrides, revoked sessions, adversarial evidence, stable error codes or server/client compatibility drift.
units.designRationale: Avoid a misleading always-403 button and ensure a recovery action targets the workspace that actually failed even if current Issue binding has changed.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS Web must render capabilities from authoritative structured grants and pin every remediation to the exact execution/data/approval contract that produced the incident.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the evidence-pinned target rule. Reject client mirrors as an authorization source: expose an ActionCapability projection from the Company OS API with stable denial codes and exact contract digest, while the server revalidates before execution.
units.responsibilityConflict: Any active non-viewer member is treated as able to see a break-glass runtime action, with no accountable-human assignment, risk level, approval receipt or data authorization visible in this helper.

units.function: Defensive parser and English formatter for the sourceResolvedWatchdogFold object stored in a Heartbeat run resultJson, including same-run evidence, silence duration, evaluation Issue and local-process cleanup outcome.
units.dependencyDirection: Pure UI parser importing the shared HeartbeatRun type. It accepts unknown JSON and does not depend on the server implementation directly, but its field literals mirror an internal resultJson shape without a schema/version discriminator.
units.keyDataModels: SourceResolvedWatchdogFold, same-run evidence identity/time, silence timestamps, evaluation Issue IDs and cleanup attempted/outcome/adapter/PID/process-group/error.
units.lifecycle: Validate required strings, default malformed cleanup to no_process_metadata, read the nested resultJson field, format cleanup outcome and silence age, and shorten evidence IDs.
units.testAssessment: No focused tests were found for this parser/formatter. The silent-run server integration suite writes a partial matching object but does not exercise UI parsing, malformed/versioned inputs, timestamp validation, unknown cleanup outcomes, zero/negative/large durations or localization.
units.designRationale: Keep unknown persisted JSON from crashing the UI and show a compact explanation of why a stale active run was folded.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs versioned, independently consumable execution/intervention receipts and UI projections that remain compatible across managed/local deployments.
units.companyOsFit: REFERENCE the defensive parsing posture, but define a versioned public receipt schema with generated validators and compatibility fixtures. Keep formatting/localization entirely in Company OS Web and never expose host PID as the primary proof of Connector cleanup.
units.responsibilityConflict: The fold receipt omits accountable human, authority/approval/data contract digests and evidence hash/signature; arbitrary cleanup strings and host-process metadata are presentation inputs rather than a verifiable responsibility record.
